assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_08d800e43586a91.text: Do you live, study, or work in a large city?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_08d800e43586a91.zh: 你住在、学习或工作在大城市吗？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_08d800e43586a91.text: Are the traffic problems so serious they often cause you to be late?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_08d800e43586a91.zh: 交通问题是否严重到经常让你迟到？
如果是这样，你并不孤单。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_08d800e43586a91.text: Over the past century, there's been a huge increase in the traffic that moves through our cities.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_08d800e43586a91.zh: 在过去一个世纪里，穿行于我们城市的交通量大幅增加。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_08d800e43586a91.text: And if, as the United Nations predicts, 70 % of the world's population will be living in cities by the year 2050,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_08d800e43586a91.zh: 如果正如联合国预测，到2050年世界70%的人口将居住在城市，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_08d800e43586a91.text: what will we do when the amount of traffic increases even more?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_08d800e43586a91.zh: 当交通量进一步增加时，我们该怎么办？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_08d800e43586a91.text: Can we do anything to control it?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_08d800e43586a91.zh: 我们能做些什么来控制它？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4dc8d67a7c111bc.text: With me in today's podcast is Mark Knowling,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4dc8d67a7c111bc.zh: 今天的播客嘉宾是马克·诺林，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4dc8d67a7c111bc.text: an expert in transport and traffic management.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4dc8d67a7c111bc.zh: 一位交通与运输管理专家。
我们的城市发生了什么？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4dc8d67a7c111bc.text: It's a fact that, in a great many cities,
the traffic is more extreme than ever before.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4dc8d67a7c111bc.zh: 交通比以往任何时候都更严重。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4dc8d67a7c111bc.text: The primary cause is that there are so many private vehicles on the roads carrying only one or two people.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4dc8d67a7c111bc.zh: 主要原因是道路上有太多私家车，每辆车只载一两个人。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4dc8d67a7c111bc.text: Compare this to buses, which are by far the most efficient option for reducing traffic,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4dc8d67a7c111bc.zh: 与公交车相比，公交无疑是减少交通最有效的选择，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4dc8d67a7c111bc.text: as they can transport huge numbers of passengers at the same time.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4dc8d67a7c111bc.zh: 因为它们可同时运送大量乘客。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4dc8d67a7c111bc.text: But people don't seem to want to leave their expensive cars at home and take the bus instead.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4dc8d67a7c111bc.zh: 但人们似乎不愿把昂贵的汽车留在家里，改乘公交车。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_780e1b91f0555e5.text: What other factors influence how well traffic flows?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_780e1b91f0555e5.zh: 还有哪些因素会影响交通是否顺畅？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_780e1b91f0555e5.text: a crash on a busy city center road can have a huge impact on all the other roads close by.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_780e1b91f0555e5.zh: 市中心繁忙道路上的一次事故，会给附近所有道路造成巨大影响。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_780e1b91f0555e5.text: Or someone parking their vehicle so that it blocks the traffic, even if only for a minute or so.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_780e1b91f0555e5.zh: 或有人停车挡住交通，哪怕只有一分钟左右。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_780e1b91f0555e5.text: can cause trouble for everyone behind them.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_780e1b91f0555e5.zh: 就能给后面的所有人制造麻烦。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_780e1b91f0555e5.text: Even something small like that means everyone's journey suddenly becomes more difficult than they expected.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_780e1b91f0555e5.zh: 即使是这样的小事，也会使每个人的出行突然变得比预想中困难。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_780e1b91f0555e5.text: It's the most annoying thing in the world.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_780e1b91f0555e5.zh: 这是世界上最让人恼火的事。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e994fbf42edad55.text: Should we blame car drivers for all this,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e994fbf42edad55.zh: 我们是否该把这一切都怪罪于汽车司机，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e994fbf42edad55.text: Traditional traffic signals in so many of our cities are years old now.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e994fbf42edad55.zh: 我们许多城市的传统交通信号灯现在都已经使用很多年了。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e994fbf42edad55.text: They always change color after a certain number of seconds.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e994fbf42edad55.zh: 它们总是在固定秒数后变灯。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e994fbf42edad55.text: That's not a sensible idea when we consider the number of vehicles driving today.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e994fbf42edad55.zh: 考虑到今天道路上的车辆数量，这并不合理。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e994fbf42edad55.text: a driver might see a green light and continue,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e994fbf42edad55.zh: 例如，司机可能看到绿灯后继续行驶，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e994fbf42edad55.text: but immediately join a long line of vehicles that isn't moving.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e994fbf42edad55.zh: 却立刻加入一条长长的、无法前行的车队。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e994fbf42edad55.text: Then, when the lights turn back to red,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e994fbf42edad55.zh: 随后，当信号灯又变红时，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e994fbf42edad55.text: they are parked across a busy junction.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e994fbf42edad55.zh: 他们就停在繁忙的十字路口中间。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e994fbf42edad55.text: That usually leads to all sorts of delays over the day.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e994fbf42edad55.zh: 这通常会导致当天出现各种延误。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d412b5aebd1edbb.text: a driver might see a green light and continue,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d412b5aebd1edbb.zh: 例如，司机可能看到绿灯后继续行驶，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d412b5aebd1edbb.text: but immediately join a long line of vehicles that isn't moving.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d412b5aebd1edbb.zh: 却立刻加入一条长长的、无法前行的车队。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d412b5aebd1edbb.text: Then, when the lights turn back to red,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d412b5aebd1edbb.zh: 随后，当信号灯又变红时，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d412b5aebd1edbb.text: they are parked across a busy junction.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d412b5aebd1edbb.zh: 他们就停在繁忙的十字路口中间。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d412b5aebd1edbb.text: That usually leads to all sorts of delays over the day.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d412b5aebd1edbb.zh: 这通常会导致当天出现各种延误。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e0d3a74db32742b.text: It means that the traffic controllers,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e0d3a74db32742b.zh: 这意味着交通控制人员，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e0d3a74db32742b.text: can check for changes in traffic throughout the day,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e0d3a74db32742b.zh: 都能查看全天交通变化，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e0d3a74db32742b.text: and figure out the best way to organize the signals to keep everything moving.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e0d3a74db32742b.zh: 并找出安排信号灯、让交通保持流动的最佳办法。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e0d3a74db32742b.text: They don't have to follow the same fixed timings for the lights all day long, like signals used to do.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e0d3a74db32742b.zh: 它们不必像过去那样，全天遵循同样固定的信号灯时长。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e0d3a74db32742b.text: And although it's expensive to put in these signals across a whole city,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e0d3a74db32742b.zh: 尽管在整座城市安装这些信号灯很昂贵，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e0d3a74db32742b.text: it's far better than doing nothing.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e0d3a74db32742b.zh: 但总比什么都不做强得多。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_19db17ece1ba4e5.text: Some tasks city governments need to do, such as checking electricity lines,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_19db17ece1ba4e5.zh: 有些城市政府需要完成的工作，例如检查电线，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_19db17ece1ba4e5.text: don't necessarily need to be carried out by a single person arriving in a big vehicle.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_19db17ece1ba4e5.zh: 不一定需要派一个人开着大车去做。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_19db17ece1ba4e5.text: A drone with a camera could send this information to engineers,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_19db17ece1ba4e5.zh: 带摄像头的无人机可以把信息传给工程师，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_19db17ece1ba4e5.text: who only need to go out if there is a problem.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_19db17ece1ba4e5.zh: 只有出现问题时，他们才需要出门。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_19db17ece1ba4e5.text: Think of how many work vans this could take off the roads every day.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_19db17ece1ba4e5.zh: 想想这每天能让多少工程车离开道路。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7396a664e288c2b.text: businesses can use drones to deliver small parcels, which is fantastic.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7396a664e288c2b.zh: 企业可以用无人机配送小包裹，这非常棒。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7396a664e288c2b.text: It means even fewer vehicles on the roads.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7396a664e288c2b.zh: 这意味着道路上的车辆会更少。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4e5e75b6c3e302e.text: When people get behind the steering wheel,
they often become less helpful than normal.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4e5e75b6c3e302e.zh: 往往会变得不如平时乐于助人。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4e5e75b6c3e302e.text: Like when someone is turning into a side street,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4e5e75b6c3e302e.zh: 比如有人要转进支路时，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4e5e75b6c3e302e.text: that often means driving across the other lane, past vehicles going in the opposite direction.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4e5e75b6c3e302e.zh: 这往往意味着要越过另一条车道，穿过对向车辆。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4e5e75b6c3e302e.text: one slows down to let in the person who wants to turn,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4e5e75b6c3e302e.zh: 没有人减速让想转弯的人先过，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4e5e75b6c3e302e.text: the traffic gets worse and worse behind them.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4e5e75b6c3e302e.zh: 后面的交通会越来越糟。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4e5e75b6c3e302e.text: Even more so if someone stops in traffic with their car across the side street that person wants to turn into.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4e5e75b6c3e302e.zh: 如果有人把车停在交通中，横在另一个人想转入的支路口，情况就更糟了。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4e5e75b6c3e302e.text: Listeners, if that doesn't annoy you as well, you're a better person than me.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4e5e75b6c3e302e.zh: 听众朋友们，如果这也不会让你恼火，那你比我好得多。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4e5e75b6c3e302e.text: Please, everyone, stop and give people enough space to turn into side streets!
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4e5e75b6c3e302e.zh: 各位，请停下来，给别人留出足够空间转进支路！

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ceb339ed452e92.text: And how can we solve these problems?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ceb339ed452e92.zh: 我们怎样解决这些问题？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ceb339ed452e92.text: Let's think again about traffic lights.
modern traffic signals can measure how quickly the vehicles are moving along the roads,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ceb339ed452e92.zh: 现代交通信号灯能够测量车辆在道路上行驶的速度，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ceb339ed452e92.text: or see whether there's been a crash,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ceb339ed452e92.zh: 或发现是否发生了事故，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ceb339ed452e92.text: and send this information back to a control center.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ceb339ed452e92.zh: 并把这些信息传回控制中心。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d425f47924df486.text: Technology, where would we be without it?
Which reminds me of another way to reduce traffic.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d425f47924df486.zh: 这让我想起另一种减少交通的方法。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d425f47924df486.text: Businesses replacing their vehicles with drones.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d425f47924df486.zh: 企业用无人机替代车辆。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e227547b0fbbf9b.text: What would you say to people who refuse to give up driving their cars ever?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e227547b0fbbf9b.zh: 对于那些永远拒绝放弃开车的人，你会怎么说？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e227547b0fbbf9b.text: I honestly think people should try to avoid driving as much as possible.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e227547b0fbbf9b.zh: 我真心认为人们应尽量避免开车。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e227547b0fbbf9b.text: But if they can't, they should consider their behavior.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e227547b0fbbf9b.zh: 但如果做不到，就应当反思自己的行为。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e227547b0fbbf9b.text: It's not just bad parking that causes traffic issues.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e227547b0fbbf9b.zh: 引发交通问题的不只是乱停车。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e227547b0fbbf9b.text: Everyone needs to be a lot more responsible as drivers.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e227547b0fbbf9b.zh: 每个人作为驾驶员都需要更有责任感。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_efc9688ca7674b3.text: Should we blame car drivers for all this,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_efc9688ca7674b3.zh: 我们是否该把这一切都怪罪于汽车司机，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_efc9688ca7674b3.text: Traditional traffic signals in so many of our cities are years old now.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_efc9688ca7674b3.zh: 我们许多城市的传统交通信号灯现在都已经使用很多年了。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_efc9688ca7674b3.text: They always change color after a certain number of seconds.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_efc9688ca7674b3.zh: 它们总是在固定秒数后变灯。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_efc9688ca7674b3.text: That's not a sensible idea when we consider the number of vehicles driving today.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_efc9688ca7674b3.zh: 考虑到今天道路上的车辆数量，这并不合理。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2e6eb154fbd5000.text: Thank you for being here today.
Welcome to the first meeting of Wheels to Work.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2e6eb154fbd5000.zh: 欢迎参加“骑车上班”小组的首次会议。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2e6eb154fbd5000.text: As you know, the goal of this group is to make our city more bicycle -friendly.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2e6eb154fbd5000.zh: 大家知道，本小组的目标是让我们的城市更适合骑自行车。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2e6eb154fbd5000.text: we'd like to make it easier for people to cycle to work.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2e6eb154fbd5000.zh: 我们希望让人们骑车上班更方便。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2e6eb154fbd5000.text: Cycling to work is good for the environment and it provides great exercise.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2e6eb154fbd5000.zh: 骑车上班有利于环境，也能提供很好的锻炼。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2e6eb154fbd5000.text: I think it's a lot of fun.
I'm hoping that we can work together to solve the problems which can make it difficult for city residents to cycle to work.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2e6eb154fbd5000.zh: 我希望我们能共同解决让城市居民难以骑车上班的问题。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2e6eb154fbd5000.text: Today, I'm going to talk about a few of those problems and share some ideas for solving them.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2e6eb154fbd5000.zh: 今天我会谈谈其中几个问题，并分享一些解决思路。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2e6eb154fbd5000.text: So, the biggest issue is safety.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2e6eb154fbd5000.zh: 所以，最大的问题是安全。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2e6eb154fbd5000.text: A lot of people would love to cycle to work, but they're scared.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2e6eb154fbd5000.zh: 很多人很想骑车上班，但他们害怕。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2e6eb154fbd5000.text: They feel that it's just too dangerous.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2e6eb154fbd5000.zh: 他们觉得实在太危险了。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2e6eb154fbd5000.text: This is because there's a lot of traffic during rush hour when most people drive to or from work and there's very little space for cyclists.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2e6eb154fbd5000.zh: 因为上下班高峰交通繁忙，骑车人可用的空间很少。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2e6eb154fbd5000.text: Many of the cycle lanes we have are too narrow and some of the busiest streets don't even have cycle lanes.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2e6eb154fbd5000.zh: 我们现有的许多自行车道太窄，一些最繁忙的街道甚至没有自行车道。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_10369731ddbe481.text: What's more, many drivers don't have respect for cyclists.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_10369731ddbe481.zh: 更重要的是，许多司机不尊重骑车人。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_10369731ddbe481.text: Cars sometimes even drive in the cycle lanes to pass other cars.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_10369731ddbe481.zh: 汽车有时甚至会驶入自行车道来超越其他汽车。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_10369731ddbe481.text: Of course, if a car hits a bicycle,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_10369731ddbe481.zh: 当然，如果汽车撞到自行车，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_10369731ddbe481.text: it's going to injure or even kill the cyclist.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_10369731ddbe481.zh: 骑车人会受伤，甚至死亡。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_10369731ddbe481.text: Many people don't have a safe place to put their bicycles while they're at work.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_10369731ddbe481.zh: 许多人上班时没有安全存放自行车的地方。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_10369731ddbe481.text: They worry that if they leave their bicycle outside,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_10369731ddbe481.zh: 他们担心把自行车停在外面，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_10369731ddbe481.text: Also, it'll get wet when it rains and get damaged over time.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_10369731ddbe481.zh: 此外，下雨时它会淋湿，日久会损坏。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_10369731ddbe481.text: A third problem is that for some people, cycling to work isn't convenient.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_10369731ddbe481.zh: 第三个问题是，对一些人来说骑车上班并不方便。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_10369731ddbe481.text: Maybe they live far from their job or maybe they sometimes work late and don't want to cycle home in the dark.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_10369731ddbe481.zh: 也许他们住得离工作地点很远，或者有时工作到很晚，不想在黑暗中骑车回家。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_10369731ddbe481.text: And a lot of people don't like to cycle in the rain.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_10369731ddbe481.zh: 而且很多人不喜欢在雨中骑车。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_10369731ddbe481.text: What if you cycle to work and then later it starts raining?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_10369731ddbe481.zh: 如果你骑车去上班，后来又开始下雨怎么办？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_10369731ddbe481.text: I can tell you that it's pretty terrible to ride home during a storm.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_10369731ddbe481.zh: 我可以告诉你，暴风雨中骑车回家相当糟糕。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_10369731ddbe481.text: those are three of the biggest issues,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_10369731ddbe481.zh: 所以，以上是三个最主要的问题：

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.text: Now I'd like to share some possible solutions.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.zh: 现在我想分享一些可行的解决办法。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.text: First, to improve safety,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.zh: 首先，为了提高安全性，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.text: I'd suggest that police officers give big fines to drivers who break the law by driving in a cycle lane.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.zh: 我建议警方对违法驶入自行车道的司机处以重罚。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.text: Also, I'd like to see wider cycle lanes to allow more bicycles to pass at the same time.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.zh: 此外，我希望看到更宽的自行车道，让更多自行车能同时通过。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.text: We should also add cycle lanes to busy streets which don't have them yet.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.zh: 我们还应在尚未设置自行车道的繁忙街道上增设自行车道。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.text: These proposals would prevent cars from hitting cyclists and would save lives.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.zh: 这些建议将防止汽车撞上骑车人，并挽救生命。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.text: As for the issue of storage,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.zh: 至于存放问题，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.text: I think that city parking garages ought to create special parking sections for bicycles.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.zh: 我认为城市停车场应该设置专门的自行车停车区。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.text: This would keep bicycles safe and dry while people are working.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.zh: 这样人们工作时，自行车就能保持安全和干燥。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.text: Finally,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.zh: 最后，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.text: convenience.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.zh: 便利性。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.text: In my opinion,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.zh: 在我看来，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.text: we should make it easier to take bicycles on public transport.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.zh: 我认为应该让人们更方便地把自行车带上公共交通。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.text: For example, we could put cycle racks on the outside of buses.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.zh: 例如，我们可以在公交车外侧安装自行车架。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.text: That way, people wouldn't have to cycle at night or in bad weather.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.zh: 这样，人们就不必在夜间或恶劣天气骑车了。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.text: And people who live far from work could cycle part of the way to work and take public transport the rest of the way.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.zh: 住得离工作地点远的人可以骑一段路去上班，剩下的路程乘坐公共交通工具。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.text: As a result,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.zh: 结果，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.text: more people could cycle to work.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.zh: 结果是，更多人可以骑车上班。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.text: Well,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.zh: 嗯，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.text: thank you again for listening to my ideas.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.zh: 那么，再次感谢大家听我分享想法。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.text: I hope this is the beginning of a conversation about how we can make this a great city for cyclists.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_cdee2f58f6a3821.zh: 我希望这是一次关于如何把城市建设得更适合骑车人的讨论的开始。
